captions.text: Kusari gives AI agents a public ENS policy and onchain trading limits.
lines: Kusari gives AI agents a public ENS policy and onchain trading limits.

captions.text: The first test is deterministic: request exactly 2 kUSD from the shared Sepolia vault.
lines: The first test is deterministic: request exactly 2 kUSD from the shared Sepolia vault.

captions.text: With the owner's per-trade cap at 5 kUSD, this request fits the amount limit.
lines: With the owner's per-trade cap at 5 kUSD, this request fits the amount limit.

captions.text: The 2 kUSD swap is confirmed on Sepolia. This is a new transaction from this recorded browser session.
lines: The 2 kUSD swap is confirmed on Sepolia. This is a new transaction from this recorded browser session.

captions.text: The owner changes the per-trade cap from 5 to 1 kUSD. The wallet writes the ENS resolver's kusari.policy data.
lines: The owner changes the per-trade cap from 5 to 1 kUSD. The wallet writes the ENS resolver's kusari.policy data.

captions.text: The ENS policy update has confirmed. Kusari now reads a 1 kUSD per-trade cap.
lines: The ENS policy update has confirmed. Kusari now reads a 1 kUSD per-trade cap.

captions.text: Run exactly the same 2 kUSD test again. It deliberately exceeds the updated 1 kUSD limit.
lines: Run exactly the same 2 kUSD test again. It deliberately exceeds the updated 1 kUSD limit.

captions.text: The receipt confirms a revert. Simulation reported ExceedsPerSwap. Only the ENS cap changed; no app or contract redeployment.
lines: The receipt confirms a revert. Simulation reported ExceedsPerSwap. Only the ENS cap changed; no app or
contract redeployment.

captions.text: Restore the cap to 5 kUSD for the next authorization check. This is another owner-approved ENS record update.
lines: Restore the cap to 5 kUSD for the next authorization check. This is another owner-approved ENS record
update.

captions.text: The restored 5 kUSD cap is confirmed. Next, test ENS authorization independently of the amount limit.
lines: The restored 5 kUSD cap is confirmed. Next, test ENS authorization independently of the amount limit.

captions.text: The owner revokes this agent's ENS authorization role in one Sepolia transaction.
lines: The owner revokes this agent's ENS authorization role in one Sepolia transaction.

captions.text: Revocation is confirmed. The agent's authority is now revoked; completed trades are not undone.
lines: Revocation is confirmed. The agent's authority is now revoked; completed trades are not undone.

captions.text: Request 2 kUSD again. It fits the restored 5 kUSD cap, but the agent no longer has ENS authorization.
lines: Request 2 kUSD again. It fits the restored 5 kUSD cap, but the agent no longer has ENS authorization.

captions.text: The receipt confirms a revert. Simulation reported NotAuthorized. A valid agent signature cannot override revocation.
lines: The receipt confirms a revert. Simulation reported NotAuthorized. A valid agent signature cannot override
revocation.

captions.text: Only the owner can grant that role again. Restore the agent's ENS authorization.
lines: Only the owner can grant that role again. Restore the agent's ENS authorization.

captions.text: Authorization is restored onchain. The agent can again execute requests that satisfy the policy.
lines: Authorization is restored onchain. The agent can again execute requests that satisfy the policy.

captions.text: Now switch from the deterministic policy test to a real Gemini decision.
lines: Now switch from the deterministic policy test to a real Gemini decision.

captions.text: Gemini reads news and pool state and may request up to 1 kUSD, or hold. The same ENS policy and hook still apply.
lines: Gemini reads news and pool state and may request up to 1 kUSD, or hold. The same ENS policy and hook still
apply.

captions.text: Gemini's requested trade is confirmed on Sepolia. The restored agent has completed the authorization loop.
lines: Gemini's requested trade is confirmed on Sepolia. The restored agent has completed the authorization loop.

captions.text: Agent reads and signed submissions use Anon-RPC and Nox. Transactions remain public; routing observations are not an anonymity proof.
lines: Agent reads and signed submissions use Anon-RPC and Nox. Transactions remain public; routing observations
are not an anonymity proof.

captions.text: AI proposes. The owner sets authority. The contracts enforce the boundary. Verify the transaction receipts and source.
lines: AI proposes. The owner sets authority. The contracts enforce the boundary. Verify the transaction receipts and
source.
